lessons.words: tug – a strong pull; pretty – beautiful; irritated – impatient about something; puzzled – confused; cheekiness – disrespectful quality; cloak – a long sleeveless coat; wrapped – covered; realised – understood
ab: Yes / No – based on the poem (p. 18)
1. The balloon man skips lunch every day.
Yes (“never seems to think of lunch”)
2. The balloon man came to the market only in summer.
No. The balloon man came to the market on market days.
3. The balloon man always sold red, purple, blue and green coloured balloons.
Yes
4. The balloon man displayed each balloon separately.
No. All the balloons are tied together with a string.
5. The balloons look beautiful if they are let into air.
Yes
6. People waited for the balloon man to let the balloons go.
No. The balloon man may let them go some day.
